_readme: Fixed daily model set for inference-optimization-daily.yml.
Each run optimizes EVERY model below once, for up to --max-hours=24, and
pulls the latest Hyperloom commit into the sandbox (same source-pin
mechanism as optimize-submit.yml). generate_hf_matrix.py carries the
framework / precision / tp / conc fields straight into the GitHub Actions
matrix; the workflow forwards them to optimize_submit.py as
--manual --framework --precision --tp --concurrency so per-model config
is FIXED (no auto-detect). Precision is per-model NATIVE because MI300X
(gfx942) has no native FP4: FP8 for R1/GLM-4.7/Qwen3-Next/MiMo/Kimi/Mixtral/
gemma-4/Qwen3-14B, BF16 for Llama-3.1-8B / Llama-2-7b / Qwen3-0.6B / Qwen3-8B,
FP4 only for MXFP4-native gpt-oss.
Parallelism: most large models use tp8; exceptions are MiniMax M2.7 (tp4 -
its FP8 block-128 weights are not divisible by 8: 1536/8=192 is not a
multiple of 128), Qwen3-14B-FP8 (tp2 - small dense), and the small dense
models Llama-2-7b / Qwen3-0.6B / Qwen3-8B (tp1, single GPU). Kimi, MiMo and
GLM-4.7 run on sglang (vLLM tp8 MLA assert / missing arch respectively).
Optional per-row fields nodes / rayjob_image drive multi-node RayJob runs
(nodes>1 => optimize_submit forces --mode claw + injects the topology).
None of the current rows use them — GLM-5 / GLM-5.1 (the only multi-node
models) were dropped 2026-06-05; the engine support is kept for future use.
repo_id MUST equal the model's sourceURL as registered in the
core42-hyperloom playground workspace (see _api_check).

_api_check.note: Pool is now 14 models (see the candidates list below for the authoritative set). The original Ready rows are pre-staged under /wekafs/models/<org>-<repo> so SaFE register hits local_path mode (no re-download); ungated/added rows download on first run. GLM-5 and GLM-5.1 were dropped 2026-06-05 (multi-node only; running single-node models here). History: substitutions vs the original wishlist were MiniMax-M3 -> MiniMax-M2.5 (no official M3) and MiMo-V2-PRO -> MiMo-V2.5-Pro. 2026-06-16: replaced MiniMax-M2.5 with meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (gated, needs HF_TOKEN) and Kimi K2.6 switched INT4 -> FP8. Later changes: dropped Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash; added zai-org/GLM-4.7-FP8, mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1, google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, Qwen/Qwen3-14B-FP8 (tp2), and small dense models NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf, Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen/Qwen3-8B (tp1).

policy.rotation: none — the whole pool runs every day (BATCH_SIZE=0).

candidates.label: DeepSeek R1
candidates.note: FP8-native upstream. MI300X has no native FP4; FP4 baseline failed to start, so baseline at FP8. sglang+tp8 starts cleanly.

candidates.label: Kimi K2.6
candidates.note: Run at FP8 (switched from INT4). vLLM tp8 hits MLA num_head%16 assert; sglang handles tp8 cleanly. sglang dynamic-quantizes to FP8 on MI300X; per-GPU memory rises vs the INT4 weights but stays within tp8 headroom.

candidates.label: MiniMax M2.7
candidates.note: FP8 block-128 native. tp8 crashes: intermediate 1536/8=192 not divisible by 128 (observed). tp4 -> 384=3x128 OK, ~54G/GPU (no OOM).

candidates.label: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
candidates.note: Most-downloaded Llama on HF (~6.44M dl). Dense 8B, BF16-native (no quantization_config); MI300X has no native FP4, so run BF16. 32 attention heads / 8 KV heads divide by tp8 cleanly. Gated repo (gated=manual): SaFE register/download needs HF_TOKEN with the Llama license accepted; not pre-staged in core42-hyperloom yet. Replaces MiniMax-M2.5 in the daily pool.

candidates.label: Qwen3-Next
candidates.note: FP8-native. A3B MoE; tp8 keeps per-GPU memory low and starts fine. -Instruct-FP8 variant also registered.

candidates.label: gpt-oss-120b
candidates.note: Ready (local_path /wekafs/models/openai-gpt-oss-120b, hasInferenceX). MXFP4-native — FP4 is a natural fit.

candidates.label: MiMo V2.5 Pro
candidates.note: vLLM lacks this arch; needs sglang 0.5.11 ROCm image (verified registered). ~963G -> tp8 required (~120G/GPU). FP8 baseline.

candidates.label: GLM 4.7
candidates.note: FP8 compressed-tensors native. Added to make the daily fixed pool 10 models; follows the existing large-FP8-MoE sglang+tp8+conc64 pattern.

candidates.label: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct v0.1
candidates.note: MixtralForCausalLM, 8 experts top-2 (~46.7B MoE), BF16 native (no quantization_config), 32k context. MI300X (gfx942) has no native FP4, so run dynamic FP8 (same large-MoE pattern as Qwen3.6). Single-node vLLM+tp8+conc64.

candidates.label: Gemma-4 26B-A4B it
candidates.note: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration — MULTIMODAL (vision+audio+text), MoE ~26B total / ~4B active, BF16 native (no quantization_config), 256k (262144) context. Stock vLLM/sglang builds do not serve gemma-4; framework=vllm with dedicated image harbor.core42.example-internal-host.invalid/sync/vllm-openai-rocm:gemma4 (auto-selected by optimize_submit for gemma-4 repos). MI300X has no native FP4 -> dynamic FP8. Gated google repo (needs HF_TOKEN with gemma access). CAVEAT: multimodal head + 256k KV cache may need higher tp / context limiting; verify it serves for text-gen before relying on results.

candidates.label: Qwen3-14B FP8
candidates.note: Dense ~14.8B (arch=Qwen3ForCausalLM, model_type=qwen3), FP8-native weights (F8_E4M3 block-quantized, ~203k dl, ungated). MI300X (gfx942) has no native FP4 so FP8 is the natural fit. 40 attention heads / 8 KV heads divide by tp2 cleanly (40/2=20, 8/2=4); small 14B dense model fits comfortably at tp2 (no need for the pool-default tp8). Single-node vLLM+tp2+conc64. Not pre-staged in core42-hyperloom yet (ungated -> SaFE register downloads on first run).

candidates.label: Llama-2 7B
candidates.note: Dense ~6.74B (arch=LlamaForCausalLM, model_type=llama), FP16/BF16 native (no quantization_config). Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf (identical 6.74B base weights, same param count) — chosen because the official repo is gated=manual and neither CI HF token can download it; the original 'meta-llama/Llama-2-7b' is also non-HF format (only consolidated .pth). MI300X has no native FP4 -> BF16. 32 heads / 32 KV (MHA). Small model -> tp1 (single GPU, most representative). Ungated -> SaFE register downloads on first run (no HF license needed); not pre-staged.

candidates.label: Qwen3-0.6B
candidates.note: Dense ~0.75B (arch=Qwen3ForCausalLM, model_type=qwen3), BF16 native (no quantization_config), ungated, ~27.8M dl. MI300X has no native FP4 -> BF16. 16 heads / 8 KV (GQA). Tiny model -> tp1 (single GPU). Not pre-staged (ungated -> SaFE register downloads on first run).

candidates.label: Qwen3-8B
candidates.note: Dense ~8.19B (arch=Qwen3ForCausalLM, model_type=qwen3), BF16 native (no quantization_config), ungated, ~13M dl. MI300X has no native FP4 -> BF16. 32 heads / 8 KV (GQA) divide by tp cleanly. Small model -> tp1 (single GPU). Not pre-staged (ungated -> SaFE register downloads on first run).
